With intelligent agreement management, Client unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using our product companies can create, commit, and manage agreements. We are seeking a skilled and motivated engineer to join our Threat Detection Engineering team for an Infrastructure-as-Code migration initiative. Reporting to the Manager of Threat Detection Engineering, you will be responsible for the migration of Microsoft Sentinel and associated Azure resources that power our threat detection capabilities to Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). This role requires a strong software engineering, DevOps, and cloud engineering foundation and a focus on system reliability. Team Overview Security Operations, comprising Threat Intel, Detection Engineering, and CSIRT, identifies and mitigates threats through detection building, alert analysis, and forensic investigations. We are proactive, engineering-oriented, intent-driven problem-solvers dedicated to securing the business. We prioritize trust, safeguarding customer data, and platform integrity. Our dynamic and global team innovates at speed with cutting-edge tech, fostering continuous improvement and proactive defense against evolving threats. Detection Engineering forms the backbone of our data platform and detection operations, designing and engineering the pipeline and developing code and detections to provide for its efficacy. This pipeline powers our software engineering-based monitoring service, enabling the identification of relevant threats and delivering actionable alerts to the CSIRT for effective response. Responsibility Transition the configuration of existing Microsoft Sentinel and Azure resources (used to collect, process, and ingest security telemetry) to Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Build, automate, and manage Azure resource configuration leveraging GitHub and Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines. Demonstrate software engineering principles throughout the migration lifecycle, including using version control, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to eliminate breaking changes and false negatives. Partner effectively with the Threat Detection Engineering team to establish repeatable, scalable documentation around automated infrastructure deployment. Clearly and concisely communicate technical security concepts, infrastructure findings, and migration status updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Basic 4+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Cybersecurity, with at least 2+ years explicitly focused on Infrastructure-as-Code automation (Terraform) and provisioning cloud platform environments. Direct, hands-on proficiency building, managing, and maintaining secure continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines within both GitHub and Azure DevOps (ADO). Deep technical expertise in provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform, including state file management, modular development, and executing zero-downtime refactoring. Direct experience configuring and optimizing Microsoft Sentinel SIEM environments, with a specific focus on deploying the associated Azure resources used for security log collection and ingestion via code. Highly proficient in programming languages like Python or Go, alongside scripting tools (e.g., PowerShell, Bash), specifically tailored for system automation, cloud platform interactions, and custom API integrations. Demonstrated ability to author clean, comprehensive engineering documentation, including architectural mappings of cloud deployments and exhaustive inventory tracking of resources maintained under Terraform management. Preferred Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field ; advanced security or cloud engineering certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate are a distinct advantage. Experience managing large-scale infrastructure deployments across complex, multi-tenant cloud environments. Strong foundational background in security-focused software engineering, DevSecOps, or automation-heavy system architecture. Proven history of collaborating effectively across engineering, infrastructure, and security operations teams to drive architectural excellence. We offer* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible A competitive salary and good compensation package Personalized career growth Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more) Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing Education reimbursement Memorable anniversary presents Corporate events and team buildings Other location-specific benefits not applicable for freelancers

review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer Position Summary The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (“the Foundation”) is seeking top talent for its Senior AI Solutions Engineer position. This position at The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (“the Foundation”) designs, builds, and supports AI-enabled applications, integrations, and workflows across the organization. The role applies generative AI, programming, systems integration, workflow automation, and low-code development to practical business needs. This is a hands-on, technical role that works with business and technical teams to identify use cases, develop secure and maintainable solutions, and move successful prototypes into supported production use. The position collaborates with senior technical staff on higher-risk or more complex designs. Key Responsibilities Work with partners to identify and assess organizational needs that could benefit from AI. Translate business needs into functional requirements and practical solution designs partnering with senior technical staff on higher-risk or more complex designs as needed Design, build, test, deploy, document, and maintain AI-enabled applications, integrations, and workflows. Apply AI capabilities such as classification, extraction, summarization, content generation, knowledge retrieval, question answering, and task completion. Connect AI models with organizational systems and data using code, APIs, scripts, connectors, and low-code platforms. Develop and test prototypes, then advance successful concepts into secure, supported production solutions, incorporating peer and senior technical review as appropriate. Partner with departmental stakeholders to evaluate outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, cost, and suitability. Improve reliability and safety through grounding, business rules, validation, exception handling, human review, and appropriate access controls. Monitor and refine deployed solutions as needs, data, models, and supporting technologies change. Explain AI capabilities, limitations, costs, and risks clearly, including when a non-AI approach would be more appropriate. Code reusable components and established practices that support efficient, responsible AI delivery. Qualifications And Skills Relevant experience developing applications, integrations, automated workflows, or other technical solutions using generative AI tools, APIs, frameworks, or platforms Ability to translate business needs into working solutions and troubleshoot across applications, data sources, integrations, and AI services Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as JavaScript, Python, C#, or PowerShell, with knowledge of APIs, webhooks, connectors, data formats, or low-code platforms Experience with prompt development, structured outputs, and evaluating AI solutions for accuracy, reliability, security, and suitability Working knowledge of application security, credential management, testing, logging, error handling, deployment, and source control practices Sound judgment in balancing business value, complexity, cost, risk, and maintainability, with strong communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences Experience with document processing, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise knowledge retrieval, agent workflows, or AI safeguards is preferred Familiarity with Microsoft enterprise technologies such as Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, Microsoft Graph, or Entra ID and integrating enterprise business systems is preferred Compensation & Benefits Individual compensation for this role is dependent on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, qualifications, skillsets, and applicable laws. In addition to salary, the Foundation offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: Multiple options for medical insurance (with the Foundation paying 90 percent of the premiums) Competitive dental and vision plans 401(k) plan with 6 percent employer contribution Flexible spending accounts Employer paid life and disability insurance 18 Vacation Days; 12 Well-Being (Sick) Days; 2 Personal Days; summer Fridays (office closure at 2pm) and a summer holiday week over July 4 Flexible work environment. We trust all employees to work closely with their manager and colleagues to determine when, where and how programs and projects get done. Employees are also eligible for a discretionary bonus on an annual basis. The Foundation provides staff and leadership cultivation through regular training courses and events. Salary Range $150,000 - $170,000 USD How To Apply Interested candidates should submit a resume and thoughtful cover letter describing through examples, their specific qualifications and interest in the position. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, please apply. Applicants who best match the position’s needs will be contacted. About Us The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research was founded in 2000 with one clear objective: accelerating meaningful therapeutic advances and, ultimately, a cure for Parkinson’s disease (PD). The Foundation applies extraordinary scientific, business and media assets to this singular focus—thus creating a unique and dynamic organization. Since inception, MJFF has quickly grown into the largest nonprofit funder of Parkinson’s disease research, having funded over $2 billion in research projects in both academic and industry labs worldwide. Visit www.michaeljfox.org for more information. Research has shown that people from marginalized communities apply to roles only when they meet 100% of the job requirements. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, and you are someone who will contribute to our efforts to build and support a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we strongly encourage you to apply.
